issues.description: The newly introduced tracker PATCH characterization callback spans 52 lines (274-325, measured using TypeScript AST function boundaries), crossing the normative function-length refactor heuristic (~50 lines). It combines fixture lookup/create, reference seeding, a nested four-table snapshot, request execution, and assertions. The normative two-stage-review contract requires a refactor round for a crossed heuristic; project exemption of test files from 300-on-touch does not exempt the function-length heuristic. Extract the snapshot or fixture setup into an in-file helper so the newly added callback falls below the threshold without weakening its assertions.
